clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowglen, the Filled Crystal Phial holds water drawn from the moonwell north of Aldrassil. Tenaron Stormgrip asks young night elves to gather it as a first lesson in Teldrassil’s sacred power.

Tenaron Stormgrip sends young night elves to gather moonwell water before they venture into the wider world. The moonwell lies in Shadowglen, and its waters hold more than spring water: they carry energies traced to the ancient Well of Eternity. Sentinels honor moonwells as shrines of Elune, while druids use their restorative power to tend nature. The arcane sorcery of old remains forbidden. Gathering the water begins a lesson in the sacrifice at Mount Hyjal and the care needed to nurture Teldrassil.
